events.title: Fed Minutes Reveal Officials Expect Another Rate Hike This Year
events.description: Most Federal Reserve officials expect to once again raise interest rates before the end of the year, according to the minutes of the central bank's September monetary policy meeting released on Wednesday. The Fed said, "Most participants assessed that another increase in the target range for the federal funds rate would likely be appropriate by year end."

events.title: Canadian Stocks Slide; TSX Down Sharply
events.description: The Canadian market, which slipped deeper into the red after a weak start, continues to languish in negative territory Wednesday afternoon, as stocks from materials, financials and industrials sectors reel under severe selling pressure. Elevated oil prices and bond yields have raised concerns about inflation, interest rates and global growth outlook.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Marginally Up
events.description: Swiss stocks swung between gains and losses on Wednesday as elevated oil prices and bond yields amid rising concerns about Middle East tensions and France's fiscal woes rendered the mood cautious.

events.title: European Stocks Fall Amid Oil, Yields Rise On Mideast Tension
events.description: European stocks closed lower Wednesday as oil prices climbed on Persian Gulf vessel attacks and bond yields jumped amid France's fiscal crisis. The Stoxx 600 fell 1%, with the DAX down 1.35% and CAC 40 declining 1.22%. Pennon Group shares crashed 17% following a £550 million rights offering and dividend reduction.

events.title: RBI Shifts To 'Calibrated Tightening' As Rate-Hiking Cycle Begins
events.description: India's central bank hiked interest rates for the first time in nearly four years and shifted the policy stance to "calibrated tightening", suggesting that policymakers have embarked on a rate-hiking cycle as the economy navigates a myriad of worries including surging oil prices, poor monsoon, weaker rupee and the geopolitical tensions worldwide.

events.title: Indian Rupee Falls To Record Low After RBI Rate Decision
events.description: The Indian rupee weakened against the U.S. dollar in the European session on Wednesday, after the Reserve Bank of India raised its benchmark interest rates by 25 basis points and changed its monetary policy stance to calibrated tightening.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Rises As Trader's Focus On U.S. Fed Minutes
events.description: The U.S. dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, as investors ?await the minutes of the Federal Reserve's September meeting for fresh clues on its monetary policy outlook.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The U.S. dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday.

events.title: Yen Rises After BoJ Sato's Hawkish Remarks
events.description: The Japanese yen strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, following hawkish remarks by Bank of Japan (BoJ) board member Ayano Sato.

events.title: Bay Street Likely To Open On Weak Note
events.description: Higher oil and global bond yields suggest a negative start for Canadian stocks on Wednesday. The mood is likely to remain cautious amid a lack of fresh data and activity is most likely to be stock specific.

events.title: Yen Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday.

events.title: Euro Falls Amid Risk-Off Mood
events.description: The euro weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, as European shares drifted lower with renewed Middle East tensions and France's deepening fiscal crisis keeping investors on edge.

events.title: German Industrial Production Rebounds
events.description: Germany's industrial production rebounded in August despite summer heatwave and geopolitical tensions, official data showed Wednesday. Industrial output expanded 2.0 percent on a monthly basis, in contrast to the 1.2 percent decrease in July, Destatis said. Production was expected to grow 0.5 percent.
